result.summary: The page layout is mostly sound, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast failure that makes its headline and subtext nearly unreadable, plus a couple of smaller styling inconsistencies.

issues.description: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are rendered in white on a very light mint green background, giving almost no contrast and making the offer effectively illegible.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a dark green/near-black color (or darken the banner background) so text meets at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons in the 'Popular right now' list are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment across all cards (e.g., semi-transparent dark scrim with white heart) for visual consistency.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail is a very pale gray while the neighboring thumbnails are dark, so the white '15–25 min' badge sits on a low-contrast background and the card looks like a broken/placeholder image.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image treatment/gradient scrim behind the ETA badge, or use a properly exposed image so the badge remains readable.
